name: Access to Work
description: A UK government scheme that can provide practical workplace support or a grant towards support for people whose disability or health condition affects their work.
intended_use: Find and apply for workplace support that may cover equipment, support workers, travel, communication support or other practical adjustments beyond an employer's normal reasonable-adjustment duty.
audience_or_context: People in paid work, about to start work or returning to work in England, Scotland or Wales whose disability or health condition affects work; official eligibility guidance includes autism, ADHD and dyslexia among examples and does not always require a diagnosis.
limitations: Northern Ireland has a different workplace-support system.
Eligibility, grant levels and application rules can change and should be checked on GOV.UK.
Civil servants normally receive workplace support through their employer rather than Access to Work.
cost_or_access_notes: This is a government support scheme rather than a commercial service; eligibility determines whether support is funded.
conflicts_of_interest: GOV.UK is the authoritative first-party source for the scheme's current rules, but this listing does not assess the scheme's effectiveness or user experience.

provenance.method: Current GOV.UK eligibility and application information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records scheme scope and access without making an outcome claim.
